 Gary Rose
 Show Most recent Most popular HALF-TIME published at 18:33 BST 18:33 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 The whistle goes for half time and Como lead after a brilliant first half.
 A lot for Manchester United to think about. They need to be much, much better.
 257 75 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:30 BST 18:30 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Noussair Mazraoui gives the ball away on the edge of the Manchester United box and Martin Baturina is on to the ball before having a pop from distance, but Senne Lammens makes the save.
 123 103 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:29 BST 18:29 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Surely Carrick has seen enough? Pull some of the senior players and give the young’uns a go. Can’t do much worse and will at least try to put in the effort required. Anything but another whimpering, passive loss.
 Tom, Canada 
 What has happened to my team? Why play players out of position and never give youth a chance?
 Roy, Bramhall 
 Image source, Reuters 
 634 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:28 BST 18:28 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Tasos Douvikas breaks away from the defence and skips past Senne Lammens before going down inside the box. Was there contact? It doesn't matter because Douvikas was flagged offside just before, but another warning for Manchester United.
 106 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 18:25 BST 18:25 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 The Manchester United defence is sliced open by a great ball from Yan Couto in midfield and Tasos Douvikas brings it down well but then lashes his shot over. That was a big chance for the hosts to get a second.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 275 109 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:24 BST 18:24 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Approaching 40 minutes and Manchester United are yet to manage a shot on target.
 332 172 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:24 BST 18:24 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 [Bruno Fernandes] is so frustrated. He's just berating everyone. No one presses with him.
 Image source, Reuters 
 343 115 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:23 BST 18:23 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Eoin (18.18) forgot talent, effort, ability to defend, score, pass…. The list goes on!
 Simon, Kent 
 333 57 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 18:22 BST 18:22 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Here come Como again as a ball is played through the Manchester United defence and Tasos Douvikas chases after it. He shoots but the angle was always against him and Senne Lammens beats the ball away at his near post.
 141 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'United are far too passive' published at 18:20 BST 18:20 BST 
 Como 1-0 Man Utd 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 United have been far too passive in this first half-hour, putting no pressure on the ball when Como have it, and also lacking composure when they do get possession.
 There is a real lack of intensity all round from Michael Carrick's side, and they are also struggling to deal with Paz whenever Como find him.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 257 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:19 BST 18:19 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 At least against Atletico Madrid Manchester United did play well after conceding early but we're just over 10 minutes away from half time and they are struggling to make a dent in the Como defence.
 190 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:18 BST 18:18 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 United are totally devoid of confidence.
 Eoin, Ireland 
 652 69 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:15 BST 18:15 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Manchester United are struggling to test this Como defence. Youri Tielemans briefly appears to peel away from the defence and get a cross in, but he's flagged offside. 
 183 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'He shouldn't have dived in' published at 18:15 BST 18:15 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 He shouldn't have dived in. [Santos] should have stayed on his feet. It was a bit of a risk. A lovely ball played out to Paz, who just keeps it in, and [Santos] dives in, as Paz scoops it over the top, but [Santos'] left foot comes in. He knows exactly what he's done.
 Image source, Reuters 
 141 83 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 18:12 BST 18:12 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 A spell of possession now for Manchester United with 25 minutes on the clock but Andrey Santos is then booked as he lunges in late on Nico Paz after the Como man had done well to stop the ball going out of play.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 205 127 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:08 BST 18:08 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 This is the first time Manchester United have conceded in the opening two minutes of back-to-back major European games (v Atlético Madrid and Como).
 They are still struggling to take control of the game with Como dominating possession. 
 353 171 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 18:07 BST 18:07 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say on this page 
 Bruno is wasted up top. At the end of last season he was bossing games from a deeper position.
 Adam, Northants 
 Image source, Reuters 
 401 148 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 18:06 BST 18:06 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Some nice one-touch football around the box by Como ends with Martin Baturina going down under a challenge inside the area. The home fans and players want a penalty but nothing is given. Baturina was certainly looking for it.
 189 248 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 18:04 BST 18:04 BST 
 Como 1-0 Manchester United 
 Better from Manchester United as Harry Maguire meets a ball into the box but cushions his header over. 
 100 105 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 No clean sheet for Man Utd published at 18:01 BST 18:01 BST 
 Como 1-0 Man Utd 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Manchester United reporter in Como 
 No matter how this game turns out, Manchester United won't be keeping a clean sheet.
 That is one (against Azerbaijan champions Sabah FK) in 11 matches in all competitions this season for Michael Carrick's men.
 Image source, Getty Images
